All 22 artifact hashes in raw-evidence-index.json verify. Notes, not defects: (1) criteria grant tolerance wider than the notes - library refresh 'up to ten seconds' (cw_live_library_update, cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft) against 'about five seconds', and time limit 'within about ten seconds' against a five-second budget; this only favours the submission, so an app refreshing every 8 s breaks the note yet passes, while no conforming app can fail. (2) cw_caret_kept_in_view offers 'Cmd+End or Cmd+ArrowDown on a Mac' where ui.md:5 says 'Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End (Cmd on a Mac)'; irrelevant on the Linux verifier browser. (3) server.js:8 also accepts an undocumented SQLITE_PATH and defaults to __dirname/app.db rather than literal /app/app.db; unreachable under test.sh because DB_PATH is always set. Run verdict PARTIAL: the scripted golden on these bytes exercised the launch contract (uid 65534, env -i, DB_PATH, cwd outside /app, one real restart) in the agent image, not through tests/test.sh in the verifier image; the hosted judge run was on an earlier candidate and is not a measurement of these bytes.
